answer: To earn settlement rights, an agent must lock earnings for ninety days, building a glacier of time-weighted stake that no shortcut can thaw. Fresh identities begin in a yarrow patch of micro-tasks capped at dust value, so a farmer spinning up hundreds of them only multiplies accounts worth nothing. Privilege unlocks with age and burned fees, and when a clerk's quill finds two identities sharing one wallet trail, both are struck and their locked stake is paid to the honest pool. Attacking then means aging real capital in public for months per puppet, a cost no sybil farm survives.
